summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Construa RH (pt-BR HR system). 23/23 pytest cases pass, including Jev AI resume screening returning real ai_score/skills/experience + Portuguese justification. Admin and employee logins both land on correct routes; all admin nav tabs load with seeded data; employee portal loads for Carlos. Role enforcement (403 for non-admin) verified on employees, departments and candidates endpoints.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event (FastAPI). Non-blocking; replace with lifespan handler eventually.
Approving an already-approved vacation is idempotent for the record but logic correctly skips balance decrement; verified. Note: no validation prevents overlapping vacation ranges per employee.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event lifecycle; migrate to lifespan context manager.
No pagination on list endpoints (employees, candidates, vacations) — fine for seeded demo but will scale poorly.
screen_resume still inserts the candidate on Jev failure with ai_classified=false — documented as intended fallback.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default) is permissive; set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly for prod.
No rate limiting / brute force protection on /api/auth/login.
test_credentials: Admin rh@construa.com / rh123456 ; Employee colaborador@construa.com / colab123
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seed is idempotent (departments>0 check). 5 departments, 6 positions, 8 employees, 3 vacations, 2 jobs created. During tests one TEST_ candidate was added via AI screening.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows green. If re-running AI test, Jev call takes ~5-10s. Candidate list is sorted desc by ai_score — the TEST_candidate created during pytest remains in DB (candidate_count on Software job increments). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
